import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
afghanistan = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
    [[[60.5, 29.3], [74.9, 29.3], [74.9, 38.5], [60.5, 38.5], [60.5, 29.3]]]
)

date_2017 = ['2017-02-01', '2017-03-01']
date_2018 = ['2018-02-01', '2018-03-01']

# 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS LST Terra 8-Day
def mask_lst_qa(image):
    qa = image.select('QC_Day')
    # Keep only good quality pixels (bits 0-1 = 00)
    mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0)
    return image.updateMask(mask)

col_2017 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A2') \
    .filterDate(date_2017[0], date_2017[1]) \
    .filterBounds(afghanistan) \
    .map(mask_lst_qa) \
    .select('LST_Day_1km')

col_2018 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A2') \
    .filterDate(date_2018[0], date_2018[1]) \
    .filterBounds(afghanistan) \
    .map(mask_lst_qa) \
    .select('LST_Day_1km')

size_2017 = col_2017.size().getInfo()
size_2018 = col_2018.size().getInfo()

print(f"2017 Images: {size_2017}")
print(f"2018 Images: {size_2018}")

if size_2017 == 0 or size_2018 == 0:
    print("Missing data for one or both years.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Create mean composites
    mean_2017 = col_2017.mean()
    mean_2018 = col_2018.mean()
    
    # 4. Check valid pixel counts
    stats_2017 = mean_2017.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count().combine(ee.Reducer.mean(), '', True),
        geometry=afghanistan,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    stats_2018 = mean_2018.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count().combine(ee.Reducer.mean(), '', True),
        geometry=afghanistan,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    count_2017 = stats_2017.get('LST_Day_1km_count').getInfo()
    count_2018 = stats_2018.get('LST_Day_1km_count').getInfo()
    val_2017 = stats_2017.get('LST_Day_1km_mean').getInfo()
    val_2018 = stats_2018.get('LST_Day_1km_mean').getInfo()
    
    print(f"2017 Valid Pixels: {count_2017}, Mean LST: {val_2017}")
    print(f"2018 Valid Pixels: {count_2018}, Mean LST: {val_2018}")
    
    if count_2017 == 0 or count_2018 == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after QC masking.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif val_2017 is None or val_2018 is None:
        print("Calculation failed - invalid values.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif val_2017 < 200 or val_2017 > 350 or val_2018 < 200 or val_2018 > 350:
        print("LST values out of valid range.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # Convert to Celsius for interpretation
        temp_2017_c = val_2017 * 0.02 - 273.15
        temp_2018_c = val_2018 * 0.02 - 273.15
        print(f"2017 Mean Temp: {temp_2017_c:.2f}°C")
        print(f"2018 Mean Temp: {temp_2018_c:.2f}°C")
        print(f"Difference: {temp_2018_c - temp_2017_c:.2f}°C")
        
        if val_2018 > val_2017:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
